name: worktrees
description: Side pane of every git worktree, grouped by repo: uncommitted work idle 7+ days in red with a one-key local WIP rescue (never pushes, skips secrets), safe-to-remove worktrees dimmed, toasts when a worktree is created or turns at risk.

roots.title: Roots

staleDays.title: Stale after (days)
